title: Flappy Wings
description: Debuff the Elytra by replacing its functionality with a Double Jump
body: Ever thought the Elytra was too **overpowered**? Or just wanted an **incentive** to use **alternative transportation** methods? Then this might be the mod for you! **Flappy Wings** replaces the behaviour of the Elytra from gliding to double jumping! It features a completely fresh **Elytra Flap mechanic**, triggered by pressing space, replacing the gliding offered by vanilla. This feature is complete with **new sounds, particles**, and **tons of config options** to **customise** the mod's behaviour to your liking. > ### ![Info symbol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d817e28316429bbd45d2951e5d8d7fba618b4c9.png) Hot Tip > This mod can also easily be used to **disable the Elytra altogether** by changing the server config. This can be configured **per dimension**, so it's possible to, for example, keep the gliding mechanic only in **The End**. ![Player playing flappy bird](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5eb77759c7562de9d6ca82eda1eb94c645459c.png) As well as **expanding on your current speed**, the Elytra flap boost also gives you a boost **in the direction you're looking**, for easy and responsive traversal. The amount of vertical and horizontal boost also vary depending on your speed before boosting, creating a **dynamic system** where the **boost responds** to how you're moving through the air. > ### ![Warning symbol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7280c9afb6e5a98d68570ec7a3399bde8d4d76c.png) Warning > > This mod can be **dangerously fun** to hop around with, and **might cause distraction** from projects. Use with caution. Triggering an Elytra flap boost also ensures that the **fall damage** from hitting the ground afterwards takes the boost into account, such that you will **never take fall damage from any height gained by the boost**. This makes sure it's relatively safe to use and your **toes stay intact**. The total config options to customise this mod with include: - Horizontal and vertical **boost amounts** - Whether **fall damage** is mitigated - What **dimensions** to be able to glide in - Whether to enable **dynamic boosts** - **Cooldown** duration between boosts > ### ![Info symbol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d817e28316429bbd45d2951e5d8d7fba618b4c9.png) Hot Tip > By default, using the Elytra to glide is still possible in **the End**, but this is **fully configurable per dimension**, including **modded dimensions**! ![A player double jumping in the overworld, but gliding in the end](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6da51dd6dfab79e12e2433b62aabf0a858c763d4_0.webp) > ### ![Info symbol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d817e28316429bbd45d2951e5d8d7fba618b4c9.png) Ideas / Requests > Do you have any **suggestions or feature requests**? Want to have the mod ported to a certain **game version** or mod launcher? Please submit a **[Github issue](https://github.com/phantomeye1931/Flappy-Wings/issues)** and I would love to include it Special thanks to [@friedkeenan](https://modrinth.com/user/friedkeenan) for logo inspiration :)
